description: A version is proposed only once it has been public for seven days, so that a release pulled or fixed in its first week never reaches a branch. internalChecksFilter is already strict by default; it is stated so that the wait is read here as holding back the branch and the pull request themselves, not only a status check on them

packageRules.description: Patch, digest and pinning updates are merged by Renovate itself once the pull request's checks pass. CI runs on every pull request, with no paths filter, so every branch Renovate opens is tested before it is merged. platformAutomerge is off so that the merge waits for those checks without relying on the repository's auto-merge setting or branch protection. Minor and major updates only open a pull request. What is merged this way reaches a release on its own through the weekly release

Workflows are already read by the github-actions manager. The actions are referenced by their major version, so only a new major opens a pull request. Grouping them keeps a handful of actions from arriving as a handful of pull requests, since they are updated together and reviewed the same way
